record.name: Bolivia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A general AI bill passed the Senate in October 2025 and is reported to be with the Chamber of Deputies; it would set up an AI regulator and have the digital government agency draft an AI strategy.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English searches returned AI-law/governance discussion but no qualifying evaluator. The cached AGETIC June 2026 bulletin concerns digital-government modernisation and participation in an AI ethics summit. This does not resolve the existing discrepancy over the proposed regulator's identity, nor does it establish a mandate to test advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The comparative legal paper discusses constitutional and regulatory context; a second substantive institutional source was not established. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: AGETIC's bulletin describes public-sector AI work and national policy development; the material reviewed does not establish a qualifying evaluation institute.

related_bodies.name: AGETIC
related_bodies.role: It is reported as regulator or strategy author under the Senate bill. It is a digital government agency. No model evaluation mandate was found.

related_bodies.name: Autoridad de Regulacion de la Inteligencia Artificial (ARIA, proposed)
related_bodies.role: It is a regulator with sanctioning powers in the Senate bill as reported; it is not an evaluation institute.

record.notes: Bill 178/2024-2025 (31 articles) is known only from press reports, which disagree on whether the regulator is a new body (named ARIA) or AGETIC itself; the bill articles were not read and no mandate to evaluate advanced models is described. Two further bills (310/2025-2026 and 288/2025-2026) were identified in a secondary search summary. The AGETIC bulletin of 29 June 2026 (primary) mentions a 'Nacion Digital' vision and an ethics summit, not an evaluation body. The Library of the Chilean Congress review (September 2026) reports that bill 178 was approved by the Senate and sent to the Chamber of Deputies, where bills 288/2025-2026 and 310/2025-2026 are also being processed; it describes bill 178 as strengthening AGETIC and setting prohibitions by severity of use.

next_check.reason: Check whether the Chamber of Deputies passed the bill and, if so, read the final text for any testing or evaluation function.
